name: 70526 · Crowley, LA
findings: ZIP 70526 (Crowley) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70526 (Crowley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
